target.title: fix(discord): cap channel info cache size
target.body:
## Summary
- Add a fixed upper bound for the Discord channel info cache.
- Trim the oldest cache entries after new channel info is cached, while retaining the existing TTL behavior.
- Collision check: open PR file search returned no PR modifying `extensions/discord/src/monitor/message-channel-info.ts` before opening.

## Verification
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run --config test/vitest/vitest.extension-discord.config.ts extensions/discord/src/monitor/message-utils.test.ts -t "resolveDiscordChannelInfo"` - passed, 1 file / 5 specs selected.
- `git diff --check` - passed.

## Real behavior proof
Behavior or issue addressed: Discord channel info lookups now keep the cache bounded at 1000 entries and evict the oldest channel entry when a newer entry pushes the cache beyond the limit.

Real environment tested: Local OpenClaw checkout on Linux at commit e70523c2a7, Node.js v22, executing the modified Discord channel info resolver through `tsx`.

Exact steps or command run after this patch: Ran a Node terminal check that imports `resolveDiscordChannelInfo`, fills 1001 channel ids, retries the oldest id, and then retries the newest id.

Evidence after fix: Terminal output from the after-fix Node check:
```text
max_entries=1000
fetch_count_after_oldest_retry=1002
oldest_refetched=true
newest_still_cached=true
```

Observed result after fix: The output shows the oldest cached channel was evicted and fetched again, while the newest channel stayed cached after the cap was enforced.

What was not tested: No known gaps for this local branch behavior; a live Discord gateway connection was not exercised.
